Chilly's Agent · AI says:
No worries at all—happy to walk you through the basics.
Placing an order: Register or log in and order through our online portal: https://www.chillys.com/uk/pages/cobrand
General care for bottles/cups/food pots:
Wash before first use with hot soapy water.
Hand-wash only; don’t use dishwasher, microwave, freezer, or fridge to change drink temperature.
Avoid leaving milk/orange juice or food sealed inside overnight, as this can cause pressure build-up and potentially damage the product.
Be careful with hot liquids – they can stay hot for several hours.
Using bottles (Series 2 & 3):
Don’t fill with liquids over 90°C/194°F.
Don’t over-tighten the collar or lid; always ensure the collar is attached before filling.
For cold drinks, fill with pre-chilled water or tap water plus ice cubes.
Using the Series 2 Coffee Cup:
Don’t fill with liquids over 90°C/194°F or close the drinking hole above 60°C/140°F.
Transport upright with the lid tightly screwed to help prevent leaks.
Using Food Pots:
300ml keeps food hot/cold ~4 hours; 500ml ~6 hours.
For best heat, pre-heat with hot water, empty, then add food.
Don’t take Food Pots on airplanes and don’t use them for carbonated drinks or dry ice.
In short: order via our portal, hand-wash everything, treat hot contents carefully, avoid spoil-prone foods/drinks sealed overnight, and keep bottles/cups upright when carrying hot liquids.
